title: Matched Campaign Cards & Swipe Guidance
changes: Fixed the lesson getting stuck after an Adaptive Micro-Practice / Listening Station intervention.
Micro-Practice now opens as an overlay and never replaces the underlying lesson card DOM, preserving all native event handlers and progression state.
Continue Lesson simply closes the intervention and returns to the already-rendered normal learning card.
Matched Japanese Journey and Japan Ready carousel card heights dynamically so swiping no longer jumps between different card heights.
Added safe top spacing inside study-mode carousel cards so active headings and icons are never clipped.
Inactive neighbouring cards now show only a subtle visual edge; their heading/icon is hidden until that card becomes active, avoiding chopped airplane/book icons.
Retains desktop side-by-side cards with both headings fully visible.
Retains all v11.8.0 Adaptive Micro-Practice scoring/cooldown behavior and v11.7.x learning-summary/touch/performance improvements.
Added a clear Journey and Japan Ready selector with full-width mobile campaign cards.
Made the mobile dashboard more compact and added persistent bottom navigation.
Improved touch target sizes, focus visibility and dashboard visual hierarchy.
Added an admin-only fully unlocked test learner for end-to-end feature testing.
Stored all test answers, settings and resumable missions separately from personal learning progress.
Paused cloud progress sync, snapshots and flushes while the test learner is active.
Added a persistent test-mode banner with one-tap return to the real profile.
Matched the Japanese Journey card structure and dimensions to Japan Ready.
Added a contextual animated swipe indicator in both campaign directions.
Kept the labelled Journey and Japan Ready selector for direct navigation.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.8.4.
